core.headline: Brook Hall: Edwardian country house with 4.5 acres, Frant
core.listing:
Brook Hall is a detached Edwardian country house built in 1908, set in approx. 4.5 acres including a 3-acre paddock, approached via a gated drive. The property stands near Frant in the High Weald National Landscape, with five bedrooms and four reception rooms.

Brick with tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. The drawing room measures 7.10m x 5.20m (23'4" x 17'1") and the dining room 5.40m x 4.60m (17'9" x 15'1").

The kitchen/breakfast room measures 8.20m x 4.90m (26'11" x 16'1").

The principal bedroom measures 5.60m x 4.80m (18'4" x 15'9"). Four bathrooms serve the five bedrooms.

The gardens include a terrace and a heated outdoor pool served by an air source heat pump. The grounds extend to approx. 4.5 acres and include the 3-acre paddock. An oak-framed triple cart lodge, built in 2025 following planning permission granted in 2025, contains a one-bedroom annexe above.

Frant station is approx. 2 miles (London Bridge approx. 1 hour); Royal Tunbridge Wells is approx. 4 miles.

Guide Price £2,100,000. Freehold. Council Tax: Band H (Wealden District Council). EPC rating: E. Construction: Standard – Brick with tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (not metered). Sewerage: Treatment plant. Heating: Oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: Limited indoors; good outdoor coverage. Parking: Gated drive with parking for several cars; triple cart lodge. The property is within the High Weald National Landscape. A public footpath crosses the southern edge of the paddock. Planning permission was granted in 2025 for the cart lodge with annexe above (built). Council tax banding of the annexe has not been confirmed.
